intent: Teach visible land after elapsed sea time, earth as potting material, soil-test order, excessive wetness for a picnic, a flat stone holding paper, waves against black rock, and wet sand versus thick mud with exact action/time clues.
picturePurpose: Original sand/mud material comparison plus three reversible coded condition diagrams, two exact evidence selections and one event-order task; no invented measurements or causal claims.
